leaders.name: Jerry Pressman
leaders.bio: Jerry Pressman serves as CTI President and helps guide the congregation as it carries its distinctive Sephardic heritage into its second century.

leaders.name: Betty Polonsky
leaders.bio: Betty Polonsky serves as Vice President and is part of the volunteer leadership supporting CTI’s religious and communal life.

leaders.name: Harvey Elefson
leaders.bio: Harvey Elefson serves as Treasurer, helping steward CTI’s financial and organizational life.

leaders.name: Joanne Pressman
leaders.bio: A descendant of CTI’s founding families, Joanne is a longtime cantorial soloist who learned the congregation’s Sephardic melodies from her family and has helped transmit them to later generations.

leaders.name: Millie Becker
leaders.bio: Millie Becker serves on CTI’s board and supports the volunteer leadership that sustains the congregation and its community.

leaders.name: Doris Hershoff
leaders.bio: Doris Hershoff is an active member of CTI and serves on the board, continuing a longstanding commitment to congregational life and community gatherings.

leaders.name: David Podradchik
leaders.bio: David Podradchik serves on CTI’s board. He is also a Massachusetts pharmacist whose professional work includes ambulatory-care pharmacy.

leaders.name: Jay Polonsky
leaders.bio: Jay Polonsky serves on CTI’s board and contributes to the congregation’s volunteer leadership and communal life.

leaders.name: Marvin Menovich
leaders.bio: Marvin Menovich serves on CTI’s board and is part of the volunteer leadership supporting the congregation.

leaders.name: Wendy Tirck
leaders.bio: Wendy Tirck serves on CTI’s board and is part of the volunteer leadership sustaining the congregation.

leaders.name: Fran Arsenault-Shaheen
leaders.bio: Fran Arsenault-Shaheen serves on CTI’s board and as President of the Ladies Auxiliary, helping organize its activities and annual luncheon.
